abstract: Maintains satellite backhaul, microwave link, and telemetry bandwidth data
system_message:
You are the Remote communications lead (RCL), responsible for maintaining satellite backhaul, microwave link, and telemetry bandwidth data across Arctic environmental science observatory plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Network latency testing（LAT）
information_points.content:
RCL-LAT-4BG：Test logs from the low-Earth-orbit terminal connected to the Whitehorse regional gateway show that the Klondike upland fixed observatory exhibits an average ping round-trip time of 75 ms under standard atmospheric conditions.
RCL-LAT-LDS：For the Aishihik Plateau containerized lab, low-Earth-orbit terminal test logs for the Whitehorse regional gateway connection reflect an average ping round-trip time of 45 ms under standard atmospheric conditions.
RCL-LAT-SSB：Low-Earth-orbit terminal test logs for the Whitehorse regional gateway connection record an average ping round-trip time of 110 ms under standard atmospheric conditions for the Takhini River valley modular station.

information_points.title: Maintains satellite backhaul, microwave link, and telemetry bandwidth data（COMM）
information_points.content:
RCL-COMM-HRB：Based on satellite ground terminal throughput tests conducted during severe winter blizzard conditions, the Aishihik Plateau containerized lab provides a high-speed telemetry bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s in continuous uplink throughput to national data centers.
RCL-COMM-XWZ：Throughput testing of the satellite ground terminal under severe winter blizzard conditions confirms that the Klondike upland fixed observatory achieves a high-speed telemetry bandwidth of 25 Mbit/s sustained uplink to national data centers.
RCL-COMM-D2P：Satellite ground terminal throughput tests during severe winter blizzard conditions indicate that the Takhini River valley modular station delivers a high-speed telemetry bandwidth of 100 Mbit/s as its minimum sustained uplink telemetry throughput to national data centers.
